items.title: TJX Stock What Changed After An Earnings Beat

The retailer pointed to 4% consolidated comparable sales growth, strong contributions from HomeGoods and international banners, and plans for roughly US$3.0b of fiscal 2027 buybacks as key supports for its off price model.
